top_story_title: PHP2shell: two unauthenticated RCE CVEs now in CISA KEV, with Cisco and Palo Alto Networks publishing portfolio impact advisories
top_story_summary: On October 21 the PHP Foundation published a Critical PHP security release fixing CVE-2026-109618 (RCE via out-of-memory corruption) and CVE-2026-109619 (RCE via stale global state), tracked publicly as PHP2shell and covered by advisories GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w and GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp. CISA added both to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-26 with a remediation due date of 2026-10-29, describing each as allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. FIRST's EPSS scores are 0.99981 and 0.99997 - effectively the ceiling, meaning exploitation activity is expected to be indiscriminate rather than targeted.
top_actions: Open the Cisco advisory cisco-sa-php-october26-Jj384Daq and the Palo Alto Networks pages for CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 today, and re-check both daily this week - both vendors state their product reviews are ongoing.

Build the candidate list from your asset inventory now: any appliance with a PHP-based web UI or management console, filtered by model and running version, so you can act the moment a product is listed.
If you are a US federal agency or follow KEV timelines, note the CISA remediation due date of 2026-10-29 and record the decision (patched / mitigated / accepted risk) per device group.

Where no fixed release is listed for your platform yet, cut exposure instead: remove HTTPS/SSH/API management from internet-facing and untrusted interfaces, restrict to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network, and put an ACL on the management plane.
Enforce MFA on all administrative and VPN accounts and remove shared local admin accounts while you wait for fixed builds.
executive_summary: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2shell, unauthenticated RCE) entered CISA KEV on 2026-10-26 with a 2026-10-29 due date and EPSS of 0.99981 / 0.99997; Cisco and Palo Alto Networks have both opened portfolio impact advisories that are still being updated.

Cisco published an informational advisory on the emergency distrust of eMudhra root and intermediate CAs: private keys for eight intermediate certificates are brute-forceable within seconds following a flawed April 2025 key generation ceremony. Audit device trust stores.
Palo Alto Networks rates the Brotli vulnerability CVE-2026-111497 as CRITICAL in its portfolio status page; EPSS is 0.36027 and the CVE is not in KEV.
No fixed release numbers were stated in any source this cycle - every upgrade path has to be read off the vendor advisory.
Nothing in this cycle is a genuine AI security event; the only AI-adjacent items are Check Point marketing for a firewall subscription model.
key_actions: **Cisco** — Read cisco-sa-php-october26-Jj384Daq directly and re-check it daily this week; it is explicitly an advisory under active update.
**Cisco** — Inventory Cisco appliances with PHP-based web or management interfaces and record model plus running version so the fix can be applied the day it is published.
**Palo Alto Networks** — Read the Palo Alto Networks pages for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 and check whether your deployed products and versions appear; re-check as the assessment is updated.
**Palo Alto Networks** — Check the vendor advisory for the fixed release - none is stated in the collected source.
**Cisco** — Read cisco-sa-emudhra-info-ScS22A1r and check whether your platforms are listed; the advisory is under active update.

**Cisco** — Audit the trust stores of firewalls, VPN gateways, load balancers, wireless controllers and management platforms for eMudhra root and intermediate CAs, and remove or explicitly distrust the affected intermediates in line with the vendor advisory.
**Palo Alto Networks** — Read the Palo Alto Networks CVE-2026-111497 page and match your deployed products and versions against the published list.
**Palo Alto Networks** — Check the vendor advisory for the fixed release and apply it in the next change window; no fixed build appears in the collected source.

ai_defenses.what_it_does: A subscription-based consumption model for Check Point firewalls, launched to replace the large up-front hardware purchase that Check Point says is stalling in capital approval cycles. The companion customer post positions it as putting "Advanced AI-Era Protection Within Reach of Every Organization".

headlines.title: Vulnerabilities in PHP Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
headlines.summary: Cisco opened a portfolio advisory for the two KEV-listed PHP2shell unauthenticated RCE flaws, with the affected-product list still being filled in.

headlines.title: CVE-2026-109618 Impact of Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) on Palo Alto Networks Products (Severity: HIGH)
headlines.summary: Palo Alto Networks published a portfolio status page rating the two KEV-listed PHP2shell RCE flaws as HIGH severity for its products.

headlines.title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
headlines.summary: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates can be brute-forced in seconds, triggering an emergency distrust and a Cisco product-impact advisory.

headlines.title: CVE-2026-111497 Portfolio Status: Impact of Brotli Vulnerability (CVE-2026-111497) on Palo Alto Networks Products (Severity: CRITICAL)
headlines.summary: Palo Alto Networks rates the Brotli compression library flaw CVE-2026-111497 as CRITICAL across its portfolio, with impact details on the vendor page.

headlines.title: This is Fine: What NetScaler Zero-Days Tell Us About the New Normal
headlines.summary: Commentary on the pace of Citrix NetScaler zero-days argues teams should keep patch pipelines primed for the next round of emergency releases.

headlines.title: Cisco Rethinks Privileged Infrastructure Access
headlines.summary: Cisco describes Privileged Infrastructure Access, which replaces standing administrator access to infrastructure with identity-bound cryptographic controls.
